notes.title: Update v.0.1.02
notes.notes:
Dear followers!

I've updated the game to version 0.1.02, let's see what's changed:

-I've added a 3 round cooldown to all active skills
-I've increased the level limit from 25 to 100
-I've reduced the starting amount of money, making a bit harder to get the best weapons
-I've reduced the increase/decrease steps for the "stamina" attribute from 5 to 2, making a bit harder to reach "more than enough" stamina for the fight
-I've expanded the tracklist with 7 new songs, so the background music will be a bit less repetitive
-I've fixed a bug, which let the AI do one more attack, even if the "bleeding" effect reduced his/her health to 0 in the round

For bug reports, suggestions, feedback (or anything else), please head to the Community Hub and tell me what's in your mind. It'll help me to improve the game. Thank you!

Don't forget to follow me on any of these:

Instagram:
https://www.instagram.com/forever.young.games/

Facebook:
https://www.facebook.com/ForeverYoungGames/

Twitter:
https://twitter.com/ForeverYoungGa1

Have a nice weekend,
Mark

notes.title: Release news (version 0.1)
notes.notes:
[h1]Dear followers![/h1]

A few days later than planned, but today I've finally released the 0.1 version of the game.
As you may suggest from the version number, this is quite an early access state, and hopefully a lot of things will change in the upcoming year (or so).
This is why I've decided to release the game for free and predictably it will stay free for the first few months.

If you'd like to take part in developing the game into something better with your suggestions, ideas or bug reports, then please head to the download page and say what you'd like to say at the Discussions.
But if you're looking for a nearly complete game or experience, then please add it your wishlist and check back later.

[h3][u]Current features:[/u][/h3]
-Highly customizable player character and randomly generated unique enemies
-Nearly 150 clothing items (pants,skirts,T-shirts,jackets,shoes and more!)
-Nearly 200 facial items (hairstyles,beards,eyes,noses,etc.)
-19 weapons, including melee weapons (like hatchet or machete), and ranged weapons (from simple pistols to machine guns and shotguns)
-Turn-based combat system
-Visible injury system, which affects gameplay too
-12 attributes to spend points on
-9 active skills and 6 passive skills to choose from
-3 locations (pub, city streets, office)
-3 different vendors (arms dealer, doctor, food vendor)
-Randomly selected map (maps are currently pre-made, later it will change)
-Beautiful hand-drawn graphics
-Hours of fun and a high replay value (due to the roguelike elements you'll never play the same level again)

[h3][u]Things I'd like to change or improve (not in order of importance, nor in chronological order):[/u][/h3]
-I'd like to add more clothing items..
-and more facial items too
-I'd like to improve the look of the city with more background items and more locations
-Totally randomized map instead of the randomly selected
-I'd like to make a robust playlist with several radio stations
-Probably more (and improved) sound effects during fight
-..and of course a lot more balanced fight system, including skill effectiveness, attributes, enemy generation and so on.

Thanks in advance for all your help, see you soon in the Community Discussions, or you can find me on:

[h3]Instagram:[/h3]
https://www.instagram.com/forever.young.games/

[h3]Facebook:[/h3]
https://www.facebook.com/ForeverYoungGames/

[h3]Twitter:[/h3]
https://twitter.com/ForeverYoungGa1

Greetings,
Mark
